Name: ai-flight-settings
Commands:
set "EC AI Flight" ai flight speed to 23
set "EC AI Flight" ai flight precision to true
set "EC AI Flight" ai flight avoidance to false
wait 1
if "EC AI Flight" ai flight speed != 23
  print "EC_FAIL: flight speed"
if not "EC AI Flight" ai flight precision
  print "EC_FAIL: flight precision"
if "EC AI Flight" ai flight avoidance
  print "EC_FAIL: flight avoidance"
set "EC AI Flight" ai flight precision to false
set "EC AI Flight" ai flight avoidance to true
if "EC AI Flight" ai flight precision
  print "EC_FAIL: flight precision reverse"
if not "EC AI Flight" ai flight avoidance
  print "EC_FAIL: flight avoidance reverse"
print "EC_PASS"

Name: ai-playback-and-flee-preconditions
Commands:
set "EC AI Recorder" ai recorder play to true
if not "EC AI Recorder" ai recorder playing
  print "EC_FAIL: recorder did not start"
else
  set "EC AI Recorder" ai recorder play to false
  if "EC AI Recorder" ai recorder playing
    print "EC_FAIL: recorder did not stop"
  else
    set "EC AI Defensive" ai defensive flee to true
    set "EC AI Defensive" ai defensive flee to false
    if "EC AI Defensive" ai defensive fleeing
      print "EC_FAIL: fleeing without movement AI or a threat"
    else
      print "EC_PASS"
